findings.F1: The tested grading is absent and its sign is wrong. Inside falling calm (477 one-day cases on BTC, XMR and DOGE), the slope of next-day excess return on the 30-day return is +0.0098 (t +0.69). By 30-day-return quintile the next-day excess runs +0.32 %, -0.54 %, -0.68 %, +0.19 %, +0.47 %, from the deepest fall (-31 %) to the shallowest, with no monotone continuation. Step 5's full test gave a slope t of -0.03 on 2502 cases.
findings.F2: Instead, the market continues the last few days' move over the next 3 to 10 days. Inside falling calm, the slope of 5-day excess return on the 3-day return is +0.39 (t +3.59, 113 cases). On the 7-day return it is +0.18 (t +2.39, 108 cases), and on the 14-day return +0.16 (t +2.32, 104 cases). At 10 days, the slope on the 14-day return has t +2.69 (50 cases). The 30-day return carries none of it (t +0.86 at 5 days, +0.92 at 10 days).
findings.F3: The short side the brief imagined exists only for the most recent fall, which a long-only book cannot take. Coins in the bottom quartile of 7-day return (mean -16 %) had a 5-day excess of -4.2 %, against +1.8 % for the top quartile (mean +11 %), over 24 cases each. At 3 days the same quartiles give -1.1 % and +0.8 %.
findings.F4: Distance above the 30-day low grades the next days the same way. Its slope on excess return has t +2.10 at 3 days (155 cases), +2.21 at 5 days (94 cases) and +2.19 at 10 days (47 cases). The 3-day quartiles run -0.15 %, -2.2 %, +1.1 %, +1.6 %, from closest to the low (+0.5 %) to furthest (+23 %).
findings.F5: The recent-move continuation belongs to the falling calm profile. Outside the profile, the 5-day slope on the 7-day return is +0.016 (t +0.48, 568 cases).
findings.F6: Inside the profile the continuation points the same way on every coin. The correlation of the 7-day return with the 5-day excess is +0.25 on BTC, +0.26 on XMR and +0.14 on DOGE. By year it is +0.29 in 2018, -0.02 in 2019 and +0.22 in 2021. These t-statistics are not clustered by day and rest on 94 to 113 cases.
findings.F7: In falling calm the coins did not keep falling on average. The mean total next-day return in the profile is +0.10 %, and the 10-day excess return is +0.64 % (47 cases). The book's -0.22 % per case is -0.7 times the 0.33 % cost of a trade. A longer horizon is needed for the move to cover that cost.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the more a coin has risen over the past 3 days, the more it rises over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In an orderly decline, a long taken after a fresh bounce should be sized by the bounce, because the recent push carries on for several days, not the fall of the past month.
ideas.name: calm-decline bounce follow-through

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the further a coin's close sits above its lowest close of the past 30 days, the more it rises over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A coin that has lifted clearly off its month's low in an orderly decline is a long to grade up, while one still sitting on its low is to be avoided.
ideas.name: lift off monthly low

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the more a coin has risen over the past 14 days, the more it rises over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A two-week recovery inside a calm decline is a slower long signal whose 10-day move is larger relative to the cost of a trade.
ideas.name: two-week recovery continues
